data.title: Hoshi X kara no Rakko
data.synopsis:
Currently, there are only three sea otters in Japan. In fact, one of them is an alien who was stranded on Earth and disguised himself to hide. Various marine creatures come to consult with this highly intelligent sea otter-like alien every day.

(Source: YouTube, translated)

data.title: Crevice
data.synopsis:
A native island girl finds a man who's washed ashore. She welcomes him in their village, and the two get to know each other. Meanwhile, the man becomes fascinated with the island's magical stone.

(Source: U-NEXT, edited)
data.background: Graduate Work 2024 by Souta Fukushima, Tama Art University.

data.title: Origami
data.synopsis:
Origami is a Japanese traditional art form of paper folding. This film explores the infinite possibilities of origami to bring life and wonder to the simplest material. Every aspect of the film is based on the skills and techniques used in actual origami art.

(Source: Official video)
data.background: Origami is the winner of the Silver Student Academy Award for Animation at the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences' 51st Student Academy Awards. It is the first Japanese work to win an award in the competition.
